newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Jan 97 foreign investment soared in Morocco - FinMin.
newsitem.headline: Jan 97 foreign investment soared in Morocco - FinMin.

text.p: Foreign investments and private loans for Morocco in January 1997 rose to 510.2 million dirhams ($54.8 million) from 169.5 million dirhams in January 1996, the Moroccan finance ministry said.

"Moreover, these receipts are the most important registered for the same period during the last five years and exceed by 62 percent the average month achievements during 1996," it said in a statement received by Reuters on Friday.

Officials were unable immediately to give a breakdown of the investments which the ministry said were even more significant as they preceded the completion of other planned investment such as that by Daewoo.
South Korea's Daewoo Corp earlier this month signed a $28 million deal under which it bought Morocco's five-star Hyatt Regency hotel, now called the Hilton Hotel.
It said it planned to invest up to $900 million in Morocco in various sectors including telecommunications.
The ministry said that investments financed by conversion of foreign public debt had totalled 120.2 million dirhams, or 23.5 percent of the total investments realised during January 1997.

This "demonstrates the interest in the reconversion mechanism initiated with France and Spain, not only to lighten the debt load but also for the relaunch of external investments and, from that, social-economic activity."
